bibliographic.title: A Cold Dark Night
bibliographic.author: Daniel Chittenden
bibliographic.description: Even when we are isolated from the world, we can not escape the world around us. What were to happen if that very world were to crash on you in the middle of the night, even in your dreams. Trapped in a cold dark house after midnight, you must find a way to survive the nightmare or wondering thoughts or risk reliving your nightmare.
